label: Estimated departure
source: QCC estimate from NORAD Tracks Santa's published 2025 schedule and press coverage of the 2025 flight. NORAD has not published a 2026 departure time.
method: Christmas Day begins first at UTC+14 (Kiritimati, Kiribati) at 10:00 UTC on 24 December. In 2025 NORAD's countdown reached zero at 09:00 UTC, when its website tracking opened, and NORAD announced the departure at about 11:00 UTC. 10:00 UTC is the midpoint and matches the first midnight.
